  requires (((lo >= 0) and (hi <= len(xs))) and (lo <= hi))
  ensures ((result == len(xs)) or (((result >= lo) and (result < hi)) and (xs[result] == x)))
  ensures ((result != len(xs)) or (not (exists i in lo..hi: (xs[i] == x))))
  effects pure

  example (search([1, 4, 6, 9], 5, 0, 4) == 4)
  example (search([1, 4, 6, 9], 9, 2, 4) == 3)

  example (collatz_steps(1) == 0)
  example (collatz_steps(7) == 16)
{
  if (n == 1) then 0 else (1 + collatz_steps(collatz_next(n)))
}

fn partners(xs: List[Int], t: Int, a: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures (result == (count y in xs: (((a + y) == t) and (y != a))))
  effects pure
  example (partners([1, 2, 3, 4], 5, 1) == 1)
  example (partners([1, 2, 3, 4], 5, 2) == 1)
  example (partners([1, 2, 3], 5, 9) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..r] => if (((a + h) == t) and (h != a)) then (1 + partners(r, t, a)) else partners(r, t, a) }
}

fn sum_partners(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int], t: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures (result == (sum a in ys: partners(xs, t, a)))
  effects pure
  example (sum_partners([1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 2, 3, 4], 5) == 4)
  example (sum_partners([1, 2], [1, 2], 9) == 0)
  example (sum_partners([1, 2, 3], [], 5) == 0)
{
  match ys { [] => 0 [h, ..r] => (partners(xs, t, h) + sum_partners(xs, r, t)) }
}

fn count_pairs_sum(xs: List[Int], t: Int) -> Int
  requires distinct(xs)
  ensures ((2 * result) == (sum a in xs: partners(xs, t, a)))
  effects pure
  example (count_pairs_sum([1, 2, 3, 4], 5) == 2)
  example (count_pairs_sum([1, 2], 9) == 0)
  example (count_pairs_sum([], 5) == 0)
  example (count_pairs_sum([1, 2, 3], 3) == 1)
  example (count_pairs_sum([3], 6) == 0)
{
  (sum_partners(xs, xs, t) / 2)
}

  ensures forall i in k..result: contains(xs, i)

}

  example (first_missing([1, 2, 4]) == 3)
  example (first_missing([3, 5]) == 1)
  example (first_missing([]) == 1)

fn interleave(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): ((result[(2 * i)] == xs[i]) and (result[((2 * i) + 1)] == ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (interleave([1, 2, 3], [7, 8, 9]) == [1, 7, 2, 8, 3, 9])
  example (interleave([], []) == [])
  example (interleave([5], [6]) == [5, 6])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [k, ..u] => ([h, k] ++ interleave(t, u)) } }
}

fn run_len(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result <= len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..result: (xs[i] == xs[0])
  ensures ((result == len(xs)) or (xs[result] != xs[0]))
  effects pure
  example (run_len([1, 1, 2]) == 2)
  example (run_len([7]) == 1)
  example (run_len([3, 3, 3, 1]) == 3)
  example (run_len([]) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => match t { [] => 1 [h2, ..t2] => if (h2 == h) then (1 + run_len(t)) else 1 } }
}

fn drop_run(xs: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) <= len(xs))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - run_len(xs)))
  effects pure
  example (drop_run([1, 1, 2]) == [2])
  example (drop_run([7]) == [])
  example (drop_run([1, 2, 2]) == [2, 2])
  example (drop_run([]) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match t { [] => [] [h2, ..t2] => if (h2 == h) then drop_run(t) else t } }
}

fn best_run(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result <= len(xs))
  ensures (result >= run_len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (best_run([1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3]) == 3)
  example (best_run([1, 2, 1]) == 1)
  example (best_run([]) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 _ => if (run_len(xs) >= best_run(drop_run(xs))) then run_len(xs) else best_run(drop_run(xs)) }
}

fn longest_run(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 1)
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures (result <= len(xs))
  ensures (result >= run_len(xs))
  effects pure
  example (longest_run([1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3]) == 3)
  example (longest_run([7]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([1, 2, 1]) == 1)
{
  best_run(xs)
}

  requires (exp >= 0)
  ensures (((exp == 0) and (result == 1)) or ((exp >= 1) and (result == (base * pow_naive(base, (exp - 1))))))
  effects pure
  example (pow_naive(2, 0) == 1)
  example (pow_naive(2, 3) == 8)
  example (pow_naive(-3, 3) == -27)
{
  if (exp == 0) then 1 else (base * pow_naive(base, (exp - 1)))
}

fn power(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (exp >= 0)
  ensures (result == pow_naive(base, exp))
  effects pure
  example (power(2, 10) == 1024)
  example (power(-3, 3) == -27)
  example (power(5, 0) == 1)
  example (power(7, 1) == 7)
{
  if (exp == 0) then 1 else if ((exp % 2) == 0) then (power(base, (exp / 2)) * power(base, (exp / 2))) else ((base * power(base, (exp / 2))) * power(base, (exp / 2)))
}

fn prefix_from(xs: List[Int], acc: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (acc + (sum j in 0..(i + 1): xs[j])))
  effects pure
  example (prefix_from([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 3, 6])
  example (prefix_from([1, 2, 3], 10) == [11, 13, 16])
  example (prefix_from([], 4) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([(acc + h)] ++ prefix_from(t, (acc + h))) }
}

  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))

  example (prefix_sums([1, 2, 3]) == [1, 3, 6])
  example (prefix_sums([]) == [])
  example (prefix_sums([2, 0, 7]) == [2, 2, 9])
  example (prefix_sums([5]) == [5])
{
  prefix_from(xs, 0)
}

fn without(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - count(xs, x)))
  ensures forall y in result: (y != x)
  ensures forall y in xs: ((y == x) or contains(result, y))
  effects pure
  example (without([1, 2, 1, 3], 1) == [2, 3])
  example (without([4, 5], 9) == [4, 5])
  example (without([], 1) == [])
  example (without([1, 1], 1) == [])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then without(t, x) else ([h] ++ without(t, x)) }
}

fn remove_all(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - count(xs, x)))
  ensures forall y in result: (y != x)
  ensures (result == without(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (remove_all([1, 2, 1, 3], 1) == [2, 3])
  example (remove_all([4, 5], 9) == [4, 5])
  example (remove_all([], 1) == [])
  example (remove_all([7, 7, 7], 7) == [])
{
  without(xs, x)
}
